body_markdown:
## **Introducing new videos all about the Tigo EI Inverter (US)**


Get to know the[EI Inverter (US)](https://www.tigoenergy.com/product/ei-inverter) with three short videos that walk you through its key features, installation process, and commissioning using the[Energy Intelligence (EI)](https://www.tigoenergy.com/monitoring) app. Whether you're new to Tigo or need a quick refresher, these short videos are a great resource for solar professionals in the field.


‍


### **1. Product Overview**


See the EI Inverter up close and learn about its design, capabilities, and how it fits into the broader[Tigo EI Residential Solution (US)](https://www.tigoenergy.com/ei-residential-solution) .


‍


### **2. Installation Process**


Follow a step-by-step guide to mounting, wiring, and initiating rapid shutdown in the EI Inverter, including key tips for a smooth installation.


‍


### **3. Commissioning Process**


Learn how to commission the EI Inverter using the[Energy Intelligence (EI)](https://www.tigoenergy.com/monitoring) app – includes system creation, layout configuration, and device connection.


‍


These videos are a quick and effective way to stay up to speed on the Tigo EI Inverter (US) – making it easier to get familiar with the product, ensure correct setup, and complete commissioning with confidence. For more in-depth technical training, visit[Tigo Academy](https://www.tigoenergy.com/tigo-academy) to get certified.
